title: Cheap-LoRA Mirror column-subspace views

random_selection.live_conflict_check: git fetch origin --prune; no MA-286 branch found

selection_history.result: competing completed FAIL selectively adopted; task/expert BOFT angle family paused

hypothesis: One shared low-rank output factor plus one compact subspace address per task can reproduce many logical adapters with fewer actual bytes than task-local Cheap-LoRA factors; unrelated maps need private low-rank factors.
physical_object: One shared B matrix of shape 16x32 over a fixed 32x16 Walsh input basis
mirror_coordinate: One uint8 m_t selects one of eight four-column subsets; selector dictionary and every task code are charged
logical_multiplicity: Eight distinct aligned task maps plus two unrelated rank-four task maps
teacher: Aligned maps W_t=U[:,S[m_t]] B_star[S[m_t],:] for m_t=0..7. Two unrelated rank-four maps use independent A_t C_t. No teacher weights are copied into student fits.

codebook.addresses: Given task descriptors, stored in each inference payload. This tests representation/storage, not task-code learning.

controls: fixed common-subspace Cheap-LoRA with task-local B
random per-task fixed-subspace Cheap-LoRA with task-local B
shared B plus one-hot subspace gate
Mirror shared B plus compact integer address

development.fitting: Pooled least squares for shared B; task-local least squares for B_t; truncated SVD rank 4 for private A_t C_t; full least squares for independent upper

review.quality: all normalized heldout MSE below 2e-15 for index, onehot, matched cLA and full controls
review.decision: No hyperparameter tuning; fixed 1e-4 private fallback. Fresh checks stability and per-task private boundary.

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
storage.codec: typed binary tensor records charge codebook, shared/private tensors, task codes/gates, method metadata, names, shapes and headers

success_gate: On every fresh world, Mirror aligned-task normalized MSE <=1e-5 and unrelated private rank-four MSE <=1e-5; payload <=0.75x matched task-local Cheap-LoRA and <=0.5x independent full. Mirror-specific PROMISING additionally requires >=10% fewer bytes than the shared-B one-hot gate at matched quality, with fit compute <=2x and inference latency <=1.25x.
failure_gate: Mirror quality/private boundary fails, or the one-hot shared-B control reaches the same function quality at within 10% payload bytes and no worse compute/runtime.
boundaries: Addresses supplied by task metadata and charged; no learned router or code inference
Fixed Walsh basis and selector dictionary
No optimizer updates; not learning-efficiency or capacity evidence
